design_rationale:
WHY THIS MAKES A GOOD TEST
The caller asks for one thing only - "work out what is owed on that booking and I'll pay whatever is
due on it now". She names no charge, no rate and no figure. To reach the scored number the agent has
to (a) read out of the published terms that the instalment called on a package is fixed only after
the package ledger carries the amendment charge owed for every change the operations desk has
approved against the package, (b) look at the change requests standing on the package, find an
approved replacement of a party member with no amendment line answering it, and work out that the
amendment charge is a problem it must resolve first, (c) price that amendment charge from four
separate rules (which approved change decides the starting amount; what the stage the package has
reached adds; how many amendment lines the ledger already carries; what the traveller club's
change-fee waivers leave payable), and only then (d) price the instalment itself from five further
rules over the same ledger plus the club and travel-protection records. Nothing is guessable: a
tool-picking agent that calls the payment tool with the "obvious" outstanding figure writes 6685.05
(the computation document read alone) instead of 2032.76; one that skips the amendment charge writes
1999.01. Both are confident, silent, wrong.

SCOPE: OCCUPIED / CLAIMED HERE / RESERVED
Occupied before this task: nothing - this is task 0 of the difficulty.
Claimed here: extended policies bundle_ext_package_amendment_charge and
bundle_ext_balance_instalment_call; task tools charge_package_amendment_6b64f72d (owner=agent) and
settle_package_instalment_b6602c09 (owner=user). Base subjects consumed: bundle_penalty_charge as an
AMENDMENT charge (charge_category amendment_fee) and bundle_final_payment_charge as a scheduled
instalment on a live package.
Reserved for task 1: the cancelled-package world - bundle_penalty_charge as a CANCELLATION penalty
and bundle_refund_payout as the money actually returned; the cancellation ladder, the administration
charge per traveller and the deposit-forfeiture rules are untouched here, as are
bundle_refund_settlement and bundle_credit. draw_counts.py --tasks 2 shows task 1 also drawing one
prerequisite problem and factor counts [5, 4], so the reserved space is exactly one root plus one
prerequisite, which the cancelled-package pair fills without reusing anything claimed above.

STEP 0 DRAW (pasted verbatim)
{"task": 0, "key": "online_travel_agency/vacation_packages_desk/0", "prerequisite_problems": 1,
 "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 5]}
Designed to it exactly: the tree has one prerequisite problem (two problems in all);
bundle_ext_package_amendment_charge takes 4 declared factors and bundle_ext_balance_instalment_call
takes 5.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD
Root problem: bundle_ext_balance_instalment_call - the problem the caller's surface request points
at ("what is owed ... pay whatever is due on it now").
Prerequisite problem: bundle_ext_package_amendment_charge.
Edge bundle_ext_balance_instalment_call <- bundle_ext_package_amendment_charge
  kind: value_input. gate: charges_standing (a real compute binding of the blocked policy).
  form: state.
  prerequisite sentence (policy_source, verbatim from the blocked policy's own rule): "The instalment
  called on a package is fixed only after the package ledger carries the amendment charge owed for
  every change the operations desk has approved against the package."
  Four-point test: (1) the ordering connective is "only after", joining this policy's own result (the
  instalment called) to what it waits on; (2) the XX side is a record-visible state - an amendment
  charge standing on the package ledger, named in the words the ledger and the package finders use -
  and names no action, no performer and no tool; (3) it carries no tool name, no policy id, no
  snake_case token and no row id; (4) its strength is "only after" and its scope is "every change the
  operations desk has approved against the package", neither wider nor narrower than the edge's
  condition.
  Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: charge_package_amendment_6b64f72d is
  the only action in this difficulty that puts an amendment charge on a package ledger (task 1's
  penalty write puts a cancellation penalty there, which is a different kind of entry and answers no
  approved change request). So the state form is legal and no fallback_reason is needed.
  Derivation the reader must make: the prerequisite sentence says the instalment waits on an amendment
  charge for every approved change -> the records show two approved change requests on this package
  (a date change from May, already answered by the date-change line of 2026-06-02, and a replacement
  of a party member approved on 2026-09-16) and no amendment line answering the second -> the only
  policy of this charter whose result IS an amendment charge entered on a package ledger is
  bundle_ext_package_amendment_charge -> its target tool is the resolving action. Exactly one reading.
  condition (handling-time state): the package ledger carries an amendment charge for every change the
  operations desk has approved against the package.
  resolved_by: charge_package_amendment_6b64f72d, owner=agent.
  Unresolved at frozen_time, by world fact: initial_state.bundle_change_requests.
  0be6f465-4d66-401c-85c6-6d3a6773c165.request_status = "approved" (a replacement of a party member,
  decided 2026-09-16) while initial_state.bundle_ledger_entries carries no row with
  charge_category = "amendment_fee" or "name_change_fee" posted after that decision - the only
  amendment-family line on the ledger is
  initial_state.bundle_ledger_entries.bccf337d-67ac-438c-9d78-b98e449d1e90.charge_category =
  "date_change_fee", posted 2026-06-02, which answers the MAY date-change request, not the September
  replacement.
  Flips to true by: the gold write at action 9 puts an amendment_fee line of 101.25 on the ledger.
  Deletion sensitivity (Step 5 run, recorded below): skip action 9 and the root's scored parameter
  moves from 2032.76 to 1999.01.
Topological order: bundle_ext_package_amendment_charge -> bundle_ext_balance_instalment_call.
Parallel edges: none (a single edge), so order_uniqueness records that there is nothing to reorder.
user_scenario mentions no prerequisite: it never names an amendment, a change request, a replacement
traveller or a charge of any kind; the caller's only business words are "what is owed" and "pay
whatever is due on it now", and every prerequisite reaction in the persona is a passive "that's fine,
go ahead" that fires only after the adviser has said something must go on the booking first.
The tool layer validates nothing: charge_package_amendment_6b64f72d and
settle_package_instalment_b6602c09 each do one ctx.find for the lead traveller and one ctx.create;
neither reads a change request, neither inspects the other's line, neither returns an Error on any
business ground. settle_package_instalment_b6602c09 would write happily with the amendment charge
still missing - the consequence shows up only in the terminal hash.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD
Write subject at action 9: bundle_penalty_charge. Base policies whose subject intersects it:
bundle_cancellation alone. Its only eligibility, places_given_up_stated, applies_to bundle_cancel and
bundle_predeposit_cancel, not to bundle_penalty_charge, so nothing gates this write and the policy is
inherited as scope: "A cancellation penalty or an amendment charge is withheld from the party" is the
family of line being written, and the charge is entered against the party as a whole
(traveller_sequence 0). No time gate on this subject, so no anchor to check.
Write subject at action 11: bundle_final_payment_charge. Base policies whose subject intersects it:
bundle_payment_schedule and bundle_club_and_corporate_interaction.
  bundle_payment_schedule.price_guarantee_elapsed (kind=time) - condition: "The balance is taken only
  when frozen time is not before the moment the operator took the party's deposit for this package
  plus the price-guarantee term of the product booked." Starting business event: the moment the
  operator took the party's deposit for this package. Authoritative anchor:
  bundle_packages.deposit_taken_at = "2026-04-25 16:08:00 CDT". Duration source:
  variants.price_guarantee_days = 14 for the Flex Bundle Package. Counting rule: whole calendar days
  from the day AFTER the deposit was taken, weekends and public holidays included. Direction:
  not_before. Boundary: inclusive. Positive case: counting from 2026-04-26, fourteen calendar days
  close on 2026-05-09; frozen time is 2026-09-17, four months past it, so the balance may be taken.
  Negative case just short of the boundary: at 2026-05-08 the term has not run out and the correct
  terminal state would be to wait rather than to take the balance. At the boundary, 2026-05-09, the
  gate is satisfied because the relation is not_before and the boundary is inclusive.
  bundle_club_and_corporate_interaction carries no structured eligibility for this subject and is
  inherited as scope: club and corporate pricing are mutually exclusive, and this package carries no
  corporate programme reference at all, so the club side is the only one live.
Eligibility carried over and still honoured although this policy computes an amount: the package
stands at deposit_held, which is a state in which the balance may still be taken rather than one in
which the package has already been cancelled or completed.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD
Target object: the single Flex Bundle Package
4251fe84-86d6-4fee-a2eb-7e8213c59cde (reference WLB7QK24M1, Lisbon, departing 2026-12-05). Correlation
key: bundle_packages.bundle_package_id, which is the parameter both task tools take and the key every
ledger row and every change request on this package carries.
Rows that enter the aggregates: the four deposit lines of 79.00 (bundle_deposit_charge), the four
agency service fee lines of 24.95 (bundle_component_charge), the instalment of 1500.00
(bundle_final_payment_charge, instalment_sequence 1) and the date-change charge of 380.00
(bundle_penalty_charge, charge_category date_change_fee).
Rows excluded and why: the operator notice line
f99b9353-cb5b-469c-b241-e197f3cac446 is a bundle_supplier_notice, carries amount_usd 0.00 and is in no
event_type filter the computes use, so it changes no figure; it is there because a real package of
this age carries operator messages, and because a careless reader might try to price it.
Existing settlements: none - no payout, no voucher and no reversal stands against this package
(credit_balance_usd 0.00, refund_form original_payment but nothing cancelled), so nothing already
settles any of the rows above.
The amendment charge the gold writes is correlated to the package, not to a traveller or a room:
traveller_sequence 0, room_sequence 0, exactly as bundle_cancellation describes a charge withheld
from the party.

WHY EACH CLASS OF SEED ROW EXISTS (and what changes if it goes)
customers row: the identity the finder and the verifier work on; the four attributes gold uses
(email, mobile, date of birth, passport last four) are all read back from it.
bundle_packages row: the holding every compute is scoped to. Its package_price_usd 7920.00,
party_adults 3, party_children 1 and rooms_or_cabins 1 decide a traveller's share (1980.00), the
number of third adults sharing (3 - 2 x 1 = 1) and the child discount base. Remove the child and both
tiers of that ladder become unreachable, since each of them requires children travelling with the
party: the priced package value falls back to the recorded 7920.00, and the party count drops to
three, which also moves the deposit difference from 484.00 to 142.00, so the scored instalment becomes
2117.28. That is a different perturbation from the factor's own baseline substitution, which holds the
party at four and gives 2231.28; the two must not be quoted for one another.
Four deposit lines of 79.00: they are the product's REDUCED promotional deposit (79.00) rather than
its standard 200.00, which is what puts the party on the first tier of the deposit-difference factor
and adds 484.00 to the call. Delete them and the deposit collected falls to nothing, so the whole
standard deposit of 800.00 falls due with this call and the scored instalment becomes 2243.42.
Four agency service fee lines of 24.95: real charges standing on the ledger (99.80) that the call
must pick up; they also make the ledger read like a real booking rather than a fixture.
Instalment line of 1500.00: it does three things - it is money already paid, it puts the package on
the "at least one instalment already taken" tier of the instalment-split factor (so the call divides
by 3 and not by 4), and it puts the amendment charge on its middle stage tier (the cancellation
administration charge once for the package rather than nothing).
Date-change charge of 380.00: money standing against the package AND the single earlier
amendment-family line that puts the amendment charge on the "exactly one such line" tier, so the
repeat multiple is one and a half rather than one.
Operator notice line: distraction with a purpose (see the business-object card).
Two change requests: the May date change (approved) explains the date-change line and is the
near-miss for the starting-amount factor - a careless reader takes the latest approved change to be
the date move and prices 95.00 x 4 = 380.00 instead of the name-change charge; the September
replacement (approved) is the one the ledger has not answered and is what the latest-approved test
actually selects.
club_memberships row: Wanderlane Platinum, active, which carries package_discount_pct 5 and
waived_change_fees_per_year 2 - both cross-difficulty inputs. Remove it and the amendment charge
doubles to 202.50, there being no waiver allowance left to read, while the club concession falls to
nothing; the loyalty concession survives, because the points rows carry the traveller's own reference
and are still counted. The scored instalment becomes 2187.95.
club_points_entries: five qualifying accruals sourced bundle_booking inside thirty-six months (5 > 3
but not > 6, so the loyalty concession is half of the desk's concession, 1 per cent and not 2); one
club_benefit_use of a waived change fee inside twelve months (1 used against an allowance of 2, so
the amendment charge is half payable and not waived outright); three spendable rows that make the
points balance credible and that the qualifying and benefit filters deliberately do not match.
care_policies row: travel protection bought with the package (linked_bundle_package_id = the package),
which is the second condition of the multi-source club concession factor; without it the concession
drops to the ladder's second tier rather than to its fall-through - one half of the tier's package
discount, 2.5 per cent - and the call moves to 2093.48. The factor's own baseline substitution, where
the concession is nothing at all, is the separate figure 2154.20.
Automatic-clause check: the base automatic provisions on this product are the balance falling due
2026-10-31 (44 days off at frozen time, so nothing has yet fallen due for non-payment), the
price-guarantee term (run out since 2026-05-09) and the excursion credit (0.00 on this product, so
nothing is granted at departure). None of them lights an obligation this task set does not carry.
Cache design: none used. bundle_packages.amount_paid_usd = 2295.80 agrees exactly with the seeded
package_paid deltas (316.00 + 99.80 + 1500.00 + 380.00), and credit_balance_usd 0.00 agrees with an
empty package_credit account, so no stale-cache trap is in play here.

FACTOR CARD - bundle_ext_package_amendment_charge (4 declared, drawn count 4)
1. amendment_starting_amount_basis (method). Ladder: latest approved change is a replacement of a
   party member -> the product's name-change charge per traveller replaced; is a date move -> the
   date-change charge per traveller on the package; is a component substitution -> the component
   change charge once; otherwise -> the administration charge per traveller on the package. Tier taken
   here: the first, because LATEST over bundle_change_requests by submitted_at among approved rows
   returns "name_change" (2026-09-14 beats 2026-05-28). Evidence rows:
   bundle_change_requests.0be6f465-... and .af74f59f-... Value produced: 75.00 x 1 = 75.00. Baseline
   (what the computation document states): the administration charge per traveller, 35.00 x 4 =
   140.00, which alone moves the result to 150.00.
2. amendment_stage_addition (parameter). Ladder: the balance due date has passed -> the cancellation
   administration charge for every traveller; it has not passed but an instalment already stands on
   the ledger -> that charge once for the package; otherwise -> nothing. Tier taken: the second
   (2026-10-31 is 44 days away and instalment line b037e92a-... stands). Value: 60.00. Baseline:
   nothing, which moves the result to 56.25.
3. amendment_repeat_multiple (parameter). Ladder: two or more amendment-family lines -> twice; exactly
   one -> one and a half; otherwise -> once. Tier taken: the second, on the single date-change line
   bccf337d-... Value: 1.5. Baseline: once, which moves the result to 67.50.
4. amendment_club_waiver_share (parameter, MULTI-SOURCE, CROSS-DIFFICULTY = club). Ladder: an active
   card whose tier waives change fees AND no waived change fee used in the last twelve months ->
   nothing payable; such a card AND at least one but fewer than the tier's yearly allowance used ->
   one half payable; otherwise -> the whole payable. Every tier beyond the fall-through combines two
   conditions over distinct evidence (the club tier parameter and a count over the club ledger) by
   "and", which is what makes it multi-source. Tier taken: the second - CPARAM('club',
   'waived_change_fees_per_year') = 2 on club_memberships.02ffe099-... and XCOUNT over
   club_points_entries of club_benefit_use / waived_change_fee inside twelve months = 1, on row
   8f6e07d7-... of 2026-03-14. Value: one half. Baseline: the whole payable, which moves the result to
   202.50.
Whole-baseline fall-back for this computation: 140.00 (the computation document alone), against a gold
of 101.25.
Near-miss planted: the May date-change request is approved and would take the second tier of factor 1
if the reader aggregated approvals instead of taking the latest; the three spendable club rows look
like club activity but match neither the qualifying filter of the loyalty factor nor the benefit
filter of the waiver factor.

FACTOR CARD - bundle_ext_balance_instalment_call (5 declared, drawn count 5)
1. instalment_priced_package_value (method). Ladder: children travelling AND fewer rooms than adults
   AND no child-discount and no third-adult-discount line on the ledger -> the price less the child
   discount on a traveller's share per child and the third-adult discount on a traveller's share per
   third adult sharing; children travelling AND at least as many rooms as adults AND no
   child-discount line -> the price less the child discount alone; otherwise -> the price as
   recorded. Tier taken: the first (1 child, 1 room against 3 adults, no discount lines).
   7920.00 - 1980.00 x 20% x 1 - 1980.00 x 12% x 1 = 7286.40. Baseline: 7920.00, which moves the
   result to 2231.28.
2. instalment_club_concession_rate (parameter, MULTI-SOURCE, CROSS-DIFFICULTY = club). Ladder: active
   card with a package discount AND protection bought with the package -> the whole of that tier's
   package discount; active card with a package discount AND no such protection -> one half of it;
   otherwise -> nothing. Tier taken: the first - CPARAM('club', 'package_discount_pct') = 5 and
   EXISTS('care', linked_bundle_package_id = this package) is true on care_policies.81a2a883-...
   Value: 5. Baseline: nothing, which moves the result to 2154.20.
3. instalment_loyalty_concession_rate (parameter, CROSS-DIFFICULTY = club). Ladder: more than twice the
   frequent-traveller threshold of package bookings in thirty-six months -> the desk's loyalty
   concession in full; more than the threshold but no more than twice it -> one half of it; otherwise
   -> nothing. Tier taken: the second - XCOUNT over club_points_entries, accrual_source bundle_booking
   and points_kind qualifying, inside thirty-six months, is 5 against a threshold of 3 and a doubled
   threshold of 6. Value: 1. Baseline: nothing, which moves the result to 2057.04.
4. instalment_deposit_difference (parameter). Ladder: the product allows a reduced promotional deposit
   AND the deposit lines come to no more than that reduced deposit for the party -> the whole
   difference to the standard deposit; the product allows it AND the lines come to more than the
   reduced but less than the standard deposit -> one half of the difference; otherwise -> nothing.
   Tier taken: the first - 4 x 79.00 = 316.00 is exactly the reduced deposit for four travellers.
   Value: 800.00 - 316.00 = 484.00. Baseline: nothing, which moves the result to 1871.42.
5. instalment_split_basis (method). Ladder: instalments allowed AND at least one already taken -> what
   is owed divided by the instalments the product allows less those taken; instalments allowed AND
   none taken -> divided by the full number; otherwise -> the whole called at once. Tier taken: the
   first (payment_plan_instalments 4, one instalment taken) so the divisor is 3. Baseline: the whole
   outstanding, which moves the result to 6098.27.
Whole-baseline fall-back for this computation: 6685.05, against a gold of 2032.76.
Cross-category reads exercised in this world: club (a value, package_discount_pct and
waived_change_fees_per_year, plus two ledger aggregates) and care (existence of protection bought with
the package). Forcing every cross-category read off in this policy alone, with the gold amendment
charge of 101.25 still standing on the ledger, moves the instalment to 2178.48; forcing them off in
both policies of the tree, so that the amendment charge itself becomes 202.50, moves it to 2212.23.
They bear weight as a whole under either reading, and neither figure is a single factor's baseline
substitution.
Base assets the factors refine, with nothing invented: bundle_amendment's name-change, date-change,
component-change and administration charges; bundle_cancellation's administration charge per traveller
and its "priced as a cancellation and a rebooking" sentence; bundle_agg_party_pricing's third-adult and
child discounts and its frequent-traveller threshold; bundle_payment_schedule's instalment plan and
promotional-deposit difference; bundle_club_and_corporate_interaction's package discount. The policy
params (the repeat uplift, the further-change multiple, the softened share, the desk's loyalty
concession and the doubled threshold) are this desk's own published schedule on top of those base
amounts; no new base rate, threshold or business effect is created.
Declared overrides: bundle_amendment's name-change clause and its "any other amendment" clause are
superseded clause by clause by this policy's own sentences, and bundle_payment_schedule's equal-
instalment sentence and bundle_club_and_corporate_interaction's deposit-date discount clause are
superseded by the instalment-split and club-concession sentences of the root policy. Every other base
clause, including the price-guarantee time gate, stays in force and is inherited.

PERSONA DESIGN
Voice: Odalys is clipped and practical, calling between site visits, with a deadline of her own (she
flies to Portugal in ten days). The information is ordered the way a busy person orders it - the goal
first, the authorisation boundary second, everything else only when asked. She volunteers the surface
goal ("work out what is owed ... pay whatever is due on it now"), the fact that she wants to press the
button herself, and nothing else. Given only on request: email, mobile, date of birth, passport last
four, and the booking reference she would rather not have to look up. Explicit cannot-answer branches:
she has never added the booking up, cannot remember what she has paid, and knows nothing about what a
club card is worth on a holiday or what the insurance has to do with it - so an adviser who asks her
for any figure gets a definite "I wouldn't trust myself to". Passive reactions, each bound to an
utterance by the adviser and never to a DB state: "that's fine, go ahead" when told something must go
on the booking first; running the payment once it is handed over; reading the confirmation back if
asked; one mild "that sounds more than I expected, can you check it against the booking" that never
supplies a number; and a natural close once she is told the payment has gone through. No headings, no
numbering, no X -> Y script.
Authority labelling: everything she states is caller_statement (identity, intent, her own preference
to pay in person). Every business fact - what has been paid, what stands on the ledger, what the
operations desk approved - is system_record and she explicitly declines to speak to it, so there is no
second credible truth anywhere in the call.
Opening-world chronology: every fact she volunteers points at a seeded row - the Flex Bundle Package
to Lisbon booked in April (quoted_date 2026-04-18), four travellers (3 adults + 1 child), a deposit in
April and one payment in the summer (the 2026-04-25 deposit lines and the 2026-06-20 instalment). She
foresees nothing gold produces: she never mentions an amendment charge, a figure, or the fact that a
payment will be split.

DIFFICULTY, AND WHERE A CARELESS AGENT GOES WRONG
- Reading the computation document alone and paying the whole outstanding: 6685.05.
- Finding every factor of the root but never discovering the prerequisite: 1999.01.
- Taking the latest approved change to be the date move (aggregating approvals instead of taking the
  latest by submitted_at): the amendment charge becomes 380.00-based and the instalment moves.
- Treating the club waiver as an outright waiver because the tier grants waivers: the amendment charge
  becomes 0.00.
- Dividing the outstanding by four instalments instead of the three still to run.
- Reading the package price rather than the priced package value for the party (missing the child and
  third-adult discounts).
- Forgetting that the deposit actually taken was the promotional one, so the difference to the
  standard deposit falls due with this call.
Each is excluded by the policy alone: the latest-approved test, the waiver-count ladder, the
instalments-already-taken ladder, the traveller's-share sentences and the deposit-difference ladder
are all stated in the rule and all rest on rows the read nodes pull into the closure.

STANDARD SOLUTION
Locate the traveller by email and mobile; verify with date of birth and passport last four; read the
package; read its ledger; read its change requests; read the club membership and the club ledger; read
the travel protection. See that the latest approved change request (a replacement of a party member,
decided 2026-09-16) has no amendment line answering it. Price the amendment charge: starting amount
75.00 x 1; stage addition 60.00; sum 135.00; repeat multiple 1.5 -> 202.50; payable share one half ->
101.25. Enter it. Then price the instalment on the world as it now stands: priced package value
7286.40; club concession 5 and loyalty concession 1, combined once -> 7286.40 x 0.94 = 6849.216;
charges standing 99.80 + 380.00 + 101.25 = 581.05; deposit difference 800.00 - 316.00 = 484.00;
payments taken 316.00 + 1500.00 = 1816.00; outstanding 6098.266; divided by the three instalments
still to run -> 2032.7553...; rounded -> 2032.76. Unlock the payment tool, hand it to the caller, and
she pays 2032.76.

RULE -> BASIS -> COMPUTE, AND THE REVERSE SWEEP
Forward: every binding of both policies that reads the world, aggregates, chooses, crosses a category
or rounds carries a verbatim rule quotation in compute_basis - latest_approved_change,
replacement_requests, balance_due_gap, instalments_taken, amendments_charged, club_waiver_allowance,
waivers_used_12m and the four ladder bindings of the prerequisite policy; per_person_price,
sharing_third_adults, child_discount_lines, third_adult_lines, club_package_rate,
protection_with_package, package_bookings_36m, the four SUM bindings, instalments_taken and the five
ladder bindings of the root policy.
Reverse: each load-bearing sentence of each rule is claimed by a binding. The sensitive words check
out - "in the last twelve months" against within_months=12, "in the last thirty-six months" against
within_months=36, "the latest change request approved" against LATEST with request_status='approved',

user_scenario:
You are Odalys Marchetti-Bramwell, a landscape architect in Chicago, fifty-something, dry and efficient on the phone because you are calling from between two site visits. Ten days from now you fly to Portugal for two weeks of work and you will be more or less unreachable, so you are ringing the vacation packages desk to get the family's December holiday off your desk while you still can. You booked a ten-night Flex Bundle Package to Lisbon back in April for the four of you and you have already put a chunk of money into it; what you want today is simple and you say so early on: you want the desk to work out what is owed on that booking and you want to pay whatever is due on it now, today, on the same card you used in April, rather than letting it drift while you are away.

You are happy for the desk to look at the booking and to do whatever paperwork its own rules require on the account, and you say so if anyone checks; the one thing you want to do yourself is the actual payment, because the card is yours and you would rather be the one pressing the button. If the adviser offers to take the payment for you, you say you would rather put it through yourself if they can set it up at their end.

You do not volunteer your details. Asked how to find you, you give the email the booking confirmations come to, odalys.mbramwell@quillmail.com, and the mobile the operator texts, 8472019463. Asked to confirm who you are, you give your date of birth, 1979-04-11, and if a second thing is wanted you read out the last four of the passport on file, 1846. You have the booking reference somewhere in your inbox and can read it out if pressed - WLB7QK24M1 - but you would rather the adviser found it from your name. Asked anything about the numbers on the booking, you say honestly that you have never added it up and would not trust yourself to; that is what you are ringing them for. If you are asked what you have paid so far, you say there was a deposit in April and one payment in the summer and you cannot remember the figures. You do not know and cannot say what the club card is worth on a holiday, what the insurance has to do with anything, or how the operator splits a balance.

Whenever the adviser says that something has to go on the booking before the figure can be settled, you do not argue and you do not ask what it is for beyond a mild 'that's fine, go ahead' - you assume they know their own rules. Once they tell you what is due and hand the payment over for you to put through, you put it through, and you read back whatever the confirmation says if they ask. If the figure they quote sounds larger than you were expecting you say so once, mildly, and ask them to check it against the booking, but you take their answer either way and you never suggest a number of your own. When you are told the payment has gone through you are content: you thank them, say that is one thing off the list before Portugal, and let the call end there.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.amendment_charge_usd: Value: 101.25. It is composed as follows. The amendment charge's starting amount: the latest change request approved against the package, taken by the moment it was submitted, is the replacement of a party member submitted 2026-09-14 (the only other approved request was submitted 2026-05-28), so the starting amount is the product's name-change charge for the Flex Bundle Package, 75.00, read against the one traveller the approved replacement requests concern: 75.00. The stage addition: the balance falls due 2026-10-31, which is 44 days after frozen time and so has not passed, while the ledger already carries an instalment of the balance (1500.00 posted 2026-06-20), so the product's cancellation administration charge is added once for the package: 60.00. The two are summed first: 135.00. The repeat multiple: the ledger carries exactly one line charged as an amendment, a name change or a date change (the date-change charge of 380.00 posted 2026-06-02), so the sum is taken at one and a half times: 202.50. The payable share: an active Wanderlane Platinum card stands in the traveller's name, its tier waives 2 change fees in a membership year, and the club ledger shows one waived change fee used on 2026-03-14, inside the last twelve months and fewer than the tier grants, so one half of the figure reached is payable: 101.25. Rounded half up to the nearest cent at the end and at no earlier point: 101.25. Any agent that reads the same rows and the same published rules converges on exactly this figure.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.instalment_amount_usd: Value: 2032.76. It is composed as follows. The priced package value: the package carries one child travelling with the party and holds one room against three adults, so it holds fewer rooms than adults, and its ledger carries no line priced as a child discount and none priced as a third-adult discount; a traveller's share of the price is 7920.00 divided by the four travellers recorded as travelling, 1980.00; an adult sharing beyond the second in the room is a third adult sharing, so 3 - 2 x 1 = 1; the priced package value is 7920.00 - 1980.00 x 20 per cent x 1 - 1980.00 x 12 per cent x 1 = 7286.40. The club concession rate: an active Wanderlane Platinum card stands in the traveller's name, its tier carries a package discount of 5 per cent, and travel protection bought with this package stands against it (certificate TGP-5518402, linked to this package), so the whole of that discount applies: 5. The loyalty concession rate: the club ledger shows 5 package bookings accrued as qualifying in the last thirty-six months, more than the frequent-traveller threshold of 3 but no more than twice it, so one half of the desk's loyalty concession of 2 applies: 1. The two rates are added into one combined rate of 6 and the priced package value is reduced once by it: 7286.40 x 0.94 = 6849.216. The charges standing on the ledger: agency service fees 4 x 24.95 = 99.80, the date-change charge 380.00 and the amendment charge entered at the preceding step 101.25, together 581.05. The deposit difference: the product allows a reduced promotional deposit of 79.00 and the four deposit lines come to 316.00, which is no more than that reduced deposit for the four travellers, so the whole difference to the product's standard deposit of 200.00 a traveller falls due with this call: 800.00 - 316.00 = 484.00. The payments already taken: deposits 316.00 and the instalment 1500.00, together 1816.00. What the package still owes is therefore 6849.216 + 581.05 + 484.00 - 1816.00 = 6098.266. The instalment split: the Flex Bundle Package allows the balance in 4 instalments and the ledger already carries 1, so what is owed is divided by the 3 still to run: 2032.7553... Rounded half up to the nearest cent at the end and at no earlier point: 2032.76. Any agent that reads the same rows and the same published rules converges on exactly this figure.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The gold write at action 9 puts a bundle_penalty_charge line of charge_category amendment_fee and amount 101.25 on this package's ledger, so every approved change is then answered and charges_standing rises from 479.80 to 581.05.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree has a single edge and therefore a single legal order: the amendment charge is entered, then the instalment is called. There are no parallel prerequisites to reorder, so no two-order comparison arises. The order is not a convention either: the two writes do not commute, because the instalment is computed from the charges standing on the ledger, and a run with the writes reversed produces 1999.01 at the payment step instead of 2032.76 and therefore a different terminal state.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the amendment charge and replaying everything else unchanged leaves charges_standing at 479.80 instead of 581.05, so what the package still owes falls from 6098.266 to 5997.016 and the scored instalment_amount_usd moves from 2032.76 to 1999.01. The terminal state also loses the amendment_fee ledger line entirely. Figures taken from the Step 5 sensitivity run recorded in design_rationale.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario never names the prerequisite problem, the amendment charge, a change request, a replacement traveller or any charge at all. The caller's business vocabulary is 'what is owed' and 'pay whatever is due on it now'; she says explicitly that she has never added the booking up and would not trust herself to. She drops no hint of the 'is there something to sort out first?' kind. Everything she contributes about the prerequisite is a passive reaction that fires only after the adviser has said something must go on the booking first, and it is a bare 'that's fine, go ahead' that names nothing.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: Neither tool validates the prerequisite. charge_package_amendment_6b64f72d performs one ctx.find on bundle_packages to read the lead traveller and one ctx.create of a ledger line; it never reads bundle_change_requests and has no branch that could refuse. settle_package_instalment_b6602c09 does the same two things and never inspects the ledger for an amendment line: called with the prerequisite unresolved it still writes faithfully, returns its ordinary receipt and gives no hint, so the whole consequence of missing the amendment charge appears only as a different terminal hash.

factor_trace: amendment_starting_amount_basis (method): the approved change requests on the package are the date change submitted 2026-05-28 and the replacement of a party member submitted 2026-09-14; the latest of them by submission is the replacement, so the first tier applies and the starting amount is the product's name-change charge of 75.00 read against the one traveller the approved replacement requests concern = 75.00. Baseline (the computation document): the product's administration charge of 35.00 read against all four travellers = 140.00, which would give 150.00.

amendment_stage_addition (parameter): the balance falls due 2026-10-31, 44 days after frozen time, so it has not passed; the ledger carries one instalment of the balance (1500.00 posted 2026-06-20), so the second tier applies and the product's cancellation administration charge is added once for the package = 60.00. Baseline: nothing added, which would give 56.25.

amendment_repeat_multiple (parameter): the ledger carries exactly one line charged as an amendment, a name change or a date change - the date-change charge of 380.00 posted 2026-06-02 - so the second tier applies and the multiple is one and a half. Baseline: once, which would give 67.50.

amendment_club_waiver_share (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty club): the active Wanderlane Platinum card grants 2 waived change fees in a membership year and the club ledger shows one use of a waived change fee on 2026-03-14, inside the last twelve months and fewer than the allowance, so the second tier applies and one half of the figure reached is payable. Baseline: the whole payable, which would give 202.50.
party_travelling (no factor): 3 adults + 1 child = 4, a plain read of the package record.
charge_before_softening (no factor): (75.00 + 60.00) x 1.5 = 202.50, plain arithmetic in the order the rule fixes.
result (no factor): 202.50 x 0.5 = 101.25, rounded half up to the cent only at the end.

factor_trace: instalment_priced_package_value (method): the package carries 1 child, holds 1 room against 3 adults and its ledger carries no child-discount and no third-adult-discount line, so the first tier applies; a traveller's share is 7920.00 / 4 = 1980.00 and the third adults sharing are 3 - 2 x 1 = 1, giving 7920.00 - 396.00 - 237.60 = 7286.40. Baseline: the package price as recorded, 7920.00, which would give 2231.28.

instalment_club_concession_rate (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty club): the active Wanderlane Platinum card carries a package discount of 5 per cent and travel protection bought with this package stands against it (certificate TGP-5518402), so the first tier applies and the whole 5 per cent is taken. Baseline: nothing, which would give 2154.20.

instalment_loyalty_concession_rate (parameter, cross-difficulty club): the club ledger shows 5 qualifying accruals sourced from package bookings inside thirty-six months, more than the frequent-traveller threshold of 3 but no more than twice it, so the second tier applies and one half of the desk's loyalty concession of 2 is taken = 1. Baseline: nothing, which would give 2057.04.

instalment_deposit_difference (parameter): the product allows a reduced promotional deposit of 79.00 and the four deposit lines come to 316.00, no more than that reduced deposit for the party, so the first tier applies and the whole difference to the standard deposit falls due now: 800.00 - 316.00 = 484.00. Baseline: nothing, which would give 1871.42.

instalment_split_basis (method): the product allows the balance in 4 instalments and the ledger already carries 1, so the first tier applies and what is owed is divided by the 3 still to run. Baseline: the whole outstanding called at once, which would give 6098.27.
per_person_price (no factor): 7920.00 / 4 = 1980.00, a plain read and division.
price_after_concessions (no factor): the two concession rates are added into 6 per cent and applied once, 7286.40 x 0.94 = 6849.216.
charges_standing (no factor, and the binding the prerequisite edge feeds): agency service fees 99.80 + date-change charge 380.00 + the amendment charge entered at action 9 of 101.25 = 581.05.
result (no factor): 6098.266 / 3 = 2032.7553..., rounded half up to the cent only at the end = 2032.76.
